resources.string: Put AK Home on your TV in one tap — phone and TV on the same Wi-Fi.
First time? Turn on debugging on the TV
Looking for TVs on your Wi-Fi…
Connect the phone to the same Wi-Fi as the TV.
Nothing yet. Is debugging on? See the guide below.
On the TV: Settings → Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code. Type the 6-digit code and the port shown there.
On the TV, choose “Always allow from this computer” and OK.
For boxes and sticks (no HDMI inputs).
For TV sets: adds an Inputs button (HDMI, AV).
Sending AK Home to the TV
AK Home is your TV\'s home screen ✓
Press Home on the remote any time. To undo, open this app and choose “Back to the original”.
AK Home did not switch anything off on this TV.
The TV\'s own home screen is back ✓
AK Home stays on this TV
No other home screen works on this TV. Without AK Home it would sit on a black screen with a dead remote, so we kept it.
On the TV open Settings ⚙️, then choose «Device Preferences».
Go down to «Build» and press OK 7 times, until it says “You are now a developer”.
Press Back once, then open «Developer options».
Turn on «USB debugging» and press OK.
Stays as it is: all your apps (%1$d) and their data.
Switched off, not deleted: %1$s — it holds the Home button. “Back to the original” turns it on again.
No home screen needs switching off.
Nothing else on the TV is deleted or changed.
Doctor: not enough space on the TV — cleared caches
Doctor: the copy was damaged — sent it again
Doctor: an older AK Home signed differently was on the TV — replaced it
Doctor: a newer AK Home was on the TV — installed this one over it
Doctor: another home screen was still active (%1$s) — switched it off too
Doctor: AK Home did not start — started it again
Doctor: the connection dropped — connected again
The TV blocks installs from a computer. In Developer options turn on “Install via USB” (Xiaomi: also “USB debugging (Security settings)”), then try again.
The Home button still opens the old home screen. Press Home on the remote and choose AK Home with “Always”.
AK Home does not start on this TV. Send us the TV model: %1$s
The TV did not answer on port 5555. Turn on “USB debugging” (and “Network debugging” if it has it) in Developer options — see the guide.
The TV did not answer in time. Is it on the same Wi-Fi, and did you press OK on “Allow debugging?”
The TV said no. Try again and choose “Always allow from this computer”.
The phone cannot reach the TV. Put both on the same Wi-Fi (not a guest network) and try again.
✓ = what we detected; tap to change
We could not tell: is it a TV set (screen) or a TV box? Choose one below.
Some boxes also have «Network debugging» or «ADB over network»: turn it on. Android 11 and newer: turn on «Wireless debugging». Then put the phone on the same Wi-Fi and tap «Install on my TV».
Xiaomi TV: its own home is switched back on (the TV needs it to start)
Xiaomi TV: AK Home is installed and opens from your apps. The Home key may still show Xiaomi’s home — switching that home off is what turned Xiaomi screens black, so we leave it on.
